name: A2D2 — Audi Autonomous Driving Dataset
description: Commercial vehicle sensor dataset from Audi AG designed for autonomous driving research. Features full 360-degree sensor coverage collected with 6 synchronized RGB cameras and 5 solid-state LiDAR sensors. Provides dense 2D semantic segmentation labels across 38 categories, 3D bounding boxes for all surrounding road agents, non-semantic recorded sequences, and bus data signals including vehicle speed, steering angle, and throttle.
